theorems.name: Submission.allard52_amcl_cutoff_sequence
theorems.statement: ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (ε : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 < ε k ∧ ε k ≤ 1) ∧ Tendsto ε atTop (𝓝 0) ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k, Antitone (φ k)) ∧ (∀ k u, 0 ≤ φ k u ∧ φ k u ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ k u, u ≤ 1 → φ k u = 1) ∧ (∀ k u, 1 + ε k ≤ u → φ k u = 0)
